description: Located within the city of Paris. Exceptional 330 m² air-conditioned villa with garden, heated outdoor pool, sauna, jacuzzi, gym, etc. (all private)A spectacular and unique place in the heart of Paris!Close to most tourist attractions and in the immediate vicinity of all shops.A place of dreams and relaxation, a breathtaking setting for an extraordinary experience in Paris!The space— EVENTS, PHOTO SHOOTS, FILMING POSSIBLE upon prior request and quotation (= special rates) —The villa is located in Paris.GARDEN:Nestled in a green setting, you will have a private garden with a refined and elegant decor:- Green wall- Outdoor kitchen with sink and plancha- Table and chairs- Garden furniture and deckchairsAn ideal place to relax and rest!THE POOL:Unique in the heart of Paris! A private outdoor swimming pool, heated all year round, measuring almost 20 m².This pool has a movable floor that allows the water depth to be adjusted:- A height of 1m60 to swim- A paddling pool mode for children or for dining with your feet in the water.- For the more athletic: counter-current swimming system and equipment for Aquatic Gym (Coach on request)The HOT TUB: Have you ever dreamed of having a luxurious spa all to yourself? Go down a few steps and discover a private world below the villa, perfect for relaxation and serenity:- Tiled jacuzzi for 10 people- Traditional lava stone sauna- Walk-in shower with whirlpool jets- Relaxation and light therapy cabin- Massage table (Masseur or body treatment on request)The HOT TUB can serve as a disco. It is equipped with sound and lights. Please note: limited sound volume!THE GYM:- Cardio: Cross trainer, exercise bike, treadmill with screens and virtual coach (Nordictrack)- Weight training machines- Weights and dumbbells- Punching bag- Pull-up bar...(Sport
